name: Boost ratio
notes: Boost is manifold pressure over barometric: the first computed signal. Pressure ratio reads it, so one computed signal feeds another (format 2). Works on any car that reports PIDs 0B and 33. With no car: havne-cli stream replay://<this repository>/tests/fixtures/replay/boost-ratio?speed=max --signals examples/boost-ratio.json --values replays MAP and baro replies and prints Boost 0, 50 and 100 kPa and Pressure Ratio 1, 1.5 and 2

source.name: Written by hand for Havne's examples
